title: Garage Force of Miami C2 house

lines.text: Most floor coating companies send a salesman to your home and won't leave until you sign. We do the complete opposite.
When you reach out, we don't send a pushy salesman to camp in your driveway until you buy.
But let's talk about what really matters, your floor.
At Garage Force, we install premium floor coatings built to last.
It's a polyaspartic coating that's up to 20 times stronger than epoxy.
It won't fade in the South Florida sun, it resists stains and hot tires, and you can get it in any color you want to match your home.
Most of our projects are finished in just one day, so you can walk on it that same evening and park your car the next morning.
And because we're a small local team without the big-company overhead, you get better materials and a better warranty at a better price.
Our floor coatings start at just $1,095, and right now we're adding free upgrades worth hundreds of dollars when you book.
Then, when you're ready, it's easy.
You book a quick, no-pressure phone call and we give you an honest estimate right over the phone.
If you like what you hear, we come out and finalize everything.
If you don't, no problem at all.
Every floor is backed by a lifetime warranty, and we're 5-star rated on Google.
Click "Get Quote" to book your quick, no-pressure phone consultation. We'll give you an honest estimate right over the phone, and we only come out if you want us to.
